items.title: UPS Partners With TikTok Shop for No-Box, No-Label Returns Service
items.summary: UPS (NYSE:UPS) has entered into a partnership with TikTok Shop to provide an exclusive no-box, no-label returns service for participating sellers on the social commerce platform in the United States. The service will be provided through Happy Returns, allowing TikTok Shop customers to return eligible products without packaging or printed shipping labels.

items.title: 3 Beaten-Down Dividend Stocks Wall Street Abandoned That Still Pay You 7%
items.summary: Wall Street has soured on UPS, General Mills, and Best Buy for very different reasons, but all three still send out checks that yield as much as 7%. Whether that income is a trap or a rare opportunity depends on what the market is actually pricing in.

items.title: Is UPS’s (UPS) Near-100% Payout Ratio Compatible With Margin Pressures From Rising Fuel Costs?
items.summary: United Parcel Service recently reported quarterly revenue of US$22.83 billion and earnings per share of US$1.76 that exceeded analyst expectations, while facing rising fuel and energy costs that are pressuring operating margins. At the same time, UPS is rolling out 2026 holiday peak demand fees, revamping its global operating model, and being highlighted as a high-yield dividend payer with a payout ratio close to 100%, sharpening investor focus on how resilient its cash flows really...
